rows.en: I am not permitted to lose.
rows.notes: Whisper dropped the final negative (yurusarenai); the sibling clip and the sense need it.

rows.en: This is the mark of an ace.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote a garbled string (shochocho...); read as 'shouchi' from the sibling clip.
Whisper wrote 'taisen taisen'; read from the sibling clip, which repeats 'daijoubu'. Kept literal.
Whisper wrote 'bujika taichou'; read as 'buji ka, taichou'.
Whisper wrote 'taisen'; read as 'taichou' (sibling clip).

rows.en: How dare you hit the Captain!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'yokubou taechaou'; read as 'yoku mo taichou o' from the sibling clip.
Whisper wrote 'nan to mo ienai' (can't put it into words); sibling clip says 'nan to iu koto da'. Chose the sibling.
Whisper wrote 'jouzen' (wrong kanji); read as 'udemae' (skill).
Whisper wrote 'ashitematomi'; read as 'ashidematoi me' (sibling clip).

rows.en: Don't let your guard down! Let's go!

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'hayai mono ga chigau'; read as 'hayai mono gachi' (sibling clip).

rows.en: I won't lose to a man.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'otoko ni wa masking'; read as 'otoko ni wa makenn' (sibling clip).

rows.en: I'm counting on you for support.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'spot'; read as 'support' (sibling clip).

rows.en: Let me see what you can do.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'kisama no tame ni'; read as 'kisama no udemae' (sibling clip).

rows.en: Follow me! I'll show you how an ace fights!
Leave the support to me. Got it?
Paired with me, you can do it.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'buji owatta yo dama'; read as 'buji owatta you da na'.
Whisper wrote 'kaaten' (curtain); read as 'kaeru zo' (sibling clip).

rows.en: Next time, I'm counting on you.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'demae'; read as 'udemae'.

rows.en: I've taken a liking to you.
I'll show you an ace's strength.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'shuuryoku' (output); read as 'jitsuryoku' (strength).

rows.en: Can you keep up with me?

rows.notes: Whisper wrote a garbled katakana string; sibling clip is 'ushiro wa makaseta, tsuite koi'.

rows.en: Let me test what you can do!
Move out! I'll show you a woman's power!
I'm taking the lead. Cover my back.
I've never felt such a rush.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'kouyouka'; read as 'kouyoukan'.

rows.en: Next time, I'm going out alone.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'tasshite' (accomplish); read as 'dasasete' (let me sortie).

rows.en: Were you even on the battlefield?

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'tema' (effort); read as 'tama' (bullets) from the sibling clip.
Whisper wrote 'shuuryoku' (output); read as 'jitsuryoku' (strength).

rows.en: Come, prepare for the next battle.
I'll rely on you next time, too.
Nice skills. Next time, it's you against me.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote a garbled opening (kabuchi mereihanuzo); read from the sibling clip, which has 'meirei ihan da zo'.

rows.en: So which one is the hotshot?

rows.notes: Zentradi language. Heard 'teeburu' (table); same clip as vps_mil_604 ('debura'), read as deburan (enemy). Zentradi words from the film's lexicon (ja.wikipedia 'Zentradi' language section; gansaito1.hatenablog.jp 2016-09-14 word list): deburan = enemy.

rows.en: I'm the one supporting you, so I won't tolerate failure.
If I can be of use, I'll support you.
Sortie at once... oh, I'm not the operator this time.
Get it together. If you fail, you'll get a lecture.
Not being the operator feels oddly unsettling.
Don't overdo it. Do you understand?
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'mujasha' (nonsense); read as 'muchasha chaa dame yo' (do not be reckless).

rows.en: Show them exactly what you can do.
